style: Four equal specimen panels, fine watercolor and colored pencil on ivory, premium naturalist field guide, no text or UI. Each complete specimen contained in its quarter with generous margins. Deer reference unchanged.

plates.content: roe deer hoof, droppings, bark rubbing, three-tine antler
four-toed oval canid footprint in soil with small claw marks; a slender twisted fox dropping with a few seeds; a fox den entrance in a grassy earth bank; a small tuft of reddish fur

narrow paired cloven hoof impression; a small pile of dark ungulate pellets; a narrow animal passage across a rocky alpine ledge; an inset close view of a chamois head with slim hooked horns, permanent horns attached to the head not shed antlers

paired cloven hoof impression in grit; a small pile of dark ungulate pellets; a detailed side-view ibex head with large curved ridged horns attached; a narrow animal passage along an alpine rocky ledge

wide two-part hoof impression with two smaller rear dewclaw impressions; a small grouping of irregular boar droppings; freshly rooted and overturned earth with roots exposed; a small muddy wallow in woodland

large raptor footprint with three toes forward and one backward and claw tips; a small bird dropping with dark and white urate portions; an alpine rock used as a perch with a golden eagle standing on it; a juvenile golden eagle in flight showing white wing patches and white tail base

vulture footprint with three forward toes and one rear toe; a bird dropping with a dark part and white urates; two griffon vultures perched on a rocky cliff ledge; a griffon vulture feeding at a small non-graphic animal carcass, no blood or gore

raptor footprint in mud with three forward toes and one rear toe; bird dropping with dark and white urate portions; a common buzzard perched on a wooden field post; a close portrait of a common buzzard calling with beak slightly open, no sound icons

owl footprint with two forward and two rear toes and claw tips; two oval owl pellets with subtle fur and bone texture, not droppings; a natural hollow in an old tree trunk; tawny owl head portrait with round dark eyes and no ear tufts

woodpecker footprint with two forward and two rear toes; a small bird dropping with dark and white urate portions; a long black woodpecker feather; black woodpecker with red crown drumming against a tree trunk, no sound symbols

long-toed heron footprint on mud, three toes forward one rear; a bird dropping with dark and white urate portions; grey heron standing still and fishing in shallow water; grey heron in flight with neck folded into an S and long legs trailing

webbed duck footprint in wet mud with three forward toes joined by webbing; a small bird dropping with dark and white urate portions; head portrait of a male mallard with green head and yellow bill; head portrait of a female mallard with mottled brown plumage

raptor footprint with three forward toes and one rear toe; bird dropping with dark and white urate portions; western marsh harrier flying low over a small reed-bed vignette with raised wings; one barred brown marsh harrier feather

large bear front-paw impression with five toes, broad pad and claws; a bear dropping containing visible berry seeds; overturned forest stones with roots and disturbed earth below; a tuft of coarse brown bear fur caught on tree bark

oval canid footprint with four toes and claw marks; a twisted dark wolf dropping with subtle hair texture; a short straight sequence of wolf paw impressions in pale snow; European wolf head in profile howling upward, no sound icons

four-toed canid footprint with claw marks; a slim dark jackal dropping; a standing golden jackal showing tawny-grey coat and slender pointed muzzle, not a fox; a close jackal head portrait calling with mouth slightly open

rodent forepaw impression with four visible toes and claws; small cylindrical herbivore droppings with plant texture; alpine marmot upright on rock whistling with mouth open, no sound icons; a little patch of cropped alpine grasses and shoots

tiny five-toed mustelid footprint with claws; a small thin twisted mustelid dropping; full-body stoat with brown summer back and white belly next to a winter-white stoat, both black tail tips; a small refuge among mossy rocks

badger footprint with five toes and conspicuous long claw marks; a small badger dropping in a shallow latrine pit; close badger face portrait with two longitudinal black stripes on a white head; a narrow well-used animal path through woodland undergrowth

bird footprint with three toes forward and one rear; a small bird dropping with dark and white urates; two glossy black alpine chough feathers; three alpine choughs flying above a small rocky alpine ledge, yellow beaks and red legs

large owl footprint with two forward toes and two rear toes and claws; two large brown owl pellets with fur and fine bone texture; a mottled barred brown eagle-owl feather; Eurasian eagle-owl head with orange eyes and ear tufts calling, no sound icons

owl footprint with two forward toes and two rear toes; two dark elongated owl pellets with fur and bone texture; a pale barn-owl feather with a warm golden speckled edge; barn owl heart-shaped white facial disk calling with beak open, no sound symbols

bird footprint with three forward toes and one rear; a small bird dropping with dark and white urates; Eurasian jay head portrait with pale speckled crown and black moustache stripe; a Eurasian jay calling in side profile, visible blue-barred wing patch, no sound symbols
